data.narrative:
Blykalla is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Janne Wallenius and Peter Szakalos that has raised $60M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 11 total comparables—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private—including peers such as Valar Atomics, Helion, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy operating in the same sector.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient depth within narrow stage and valuation-tier filters; only one same-stage and one adjacent-stage nuclear peer could be identified in the dataset. Consequently, analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $60M total capital raised as a valuation proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $114M.

The triangulated range supports a valuation of $97M–$131M, with a median of $114M. This reflects a single methodological input; the primary uncertainty lies in whether comparable-company multiples would tighten or widen this band if a more robust peer dataset emerged within the nuclear energy subsector. The 1.9x multiplier assumption is standard for the progression from Series B to subsequent funding rounds but should be stress-tested against actual exit multiples if additional transaction data becomes available.
